description: Previsión de tráfico marítimo is a dataset listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Autoridad Portuaria de Baleares. Forecast of maritime traffic (entries and exits) in ports managed by the Port Authority of the Balearic Islands: Palma, Alcúdia, Maó, Eivissa i La Savina. Coverage: Autoridad Portuaria de Baleares. The portal shows the English title as "Forecast of maritime traffic" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Autoridad Portuaria de Baleares. Its keywords include tráfico marítimo, puertos. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://seu.portsdebalears.gob.es/seuapb/fitxa/7796/condicions-dades-obertes). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
